app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.source: The resource name of an already-uploaded file to import (e.g., `files/abc-123`). Use this or `file` to upload a new file directly
app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.message: 要匯入的已上傳檔案的資源名稱 (例如 `files/abc-123`)。使用此項或 `file` 直接上傳新檔案

app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.source: The name of the file search store to import the file into
app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.message: 要將檔案匯入其中的檔案搜尋存放區名稱

app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.source: The file search store to import into
app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.message: 要匯入的檔案搜尋存放區

app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.source: Import an uploaded file into a file search store
app.R2VtaW5p.action.aW1wb3J0LWZpbGUtdG8t.message: 將已上傳的檔案匯入至檔案搜尋存放區

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Google Gemini** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Google Gemini** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑 (相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL)、選用查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊形式傳回。

針對尚未在此應用程式上作為一級動作公開的端點使用此動作。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 選擇主體序列化模式及對應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重新配置 `body` 編輯器 — 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart 表單會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 相於連線 API 基底 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 相對於連線 API 基礎 URL 的 URI 路徑

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.s.source: Make a custom API call to Google Gemini
app.R2VtaW5p.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.s.message: 向 Google Gemini 發出自訂 API 呼叫

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.desc.source: Chat with a Gemini model by sending a single message and receiving a single reply. Simplifies the API by handling message formatting automatically
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.desc.message: 透過發送單一訊息並接收單一回覆來與 Gemini 模型對話。透過自動處理訊息格式來簡化 API

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: The text content of the message to send to the model
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 要發送給模型的訊息文字內容

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: The model name to use for generation (e.g., `gemini-2.5-flash`)
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 用於生成的模型名稱（例如 `gemini-2.5-flash`）

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: The model to use for generation
The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 回應中產生的最大權杖 (Token) 數量

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: Maximum number of tokens to generate
Optional system instruction text that sets the behavior and context for the model
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 為模型設定行為和情境的選用系統指示文字

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: The role of the message author (default: `user`)
The role of the message author
The maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 取樣時要考慮的最大權杖數量

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: The maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 取樣時要考慮的權杖最大累積機率

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.source: Controls the randomness of the output. Values range from `0.0` to `2.0`
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.opti.message: 控制輸出的隨機性。值範圍從 `0.0` 到 `2.0`

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c2ltcGxlLWNoYXQ.shor.message: 透過傳送一則訊息進行對話

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Stream content generation from a Gemini model via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Provides incremental responses as the model generates content
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 透過伺服器發送事件 (SSE) 從 Gemini 模型串流生成內容。在模型生成內容時提供增量回應

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Stream Content
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 串流內容

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: The content of the current conversation with the model. For single-turn queries, this is a single message. For multi-turn queries, this is a repeated field that contains conversation history and the latest request. For simple text prompts, use the `prompt` field instead
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 與模型目前對話的內容。對於單輪查詢，這是單一訊息。對於多輪查詢，這是包含對話歷程記錄與最新請求的重複欄位。若是簡單文字提示，請改用 `prompt` 欄位

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Contents
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 內容

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: The conversation contents for multi-turn or multimodal input
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於多輪或多模態輸入的對話內容

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Configuration options for model generation and outputs
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 模型生成與輸出的設定選項

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Generation Config
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 生成設定

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Configuration for generation
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 生成相關設定

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: The name of a file search store to use for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The model will search the store's documents to ground its response with relevant content

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: File Search Store
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 檔案搜尋存放區

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於 RAG 參考依據的檔案搜尋存放區

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: The model name to use for generation (e.g., `gemini-2.5-flash`)
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於生成的模型名稱（例如 `gemini-2.5-flash`）

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Model
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 模型

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: The model to use for generation
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於生成的模型

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: A list of unique safety settings for blocking unsafe content
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於封鎖不安全內容的專屬安全設定清單

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Safety Settings
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 安全設定

app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..source: Safety settings for content filtering
app.R2VtaW5p.action.c3RyZWFtLWNvbnRlbnQ..message: 用於內容篩選的安全設定
